design_reference.source_kind: Third-party design analysis, not official Apple guidance

tokens.font_licensing: SIL OFL; copy fonts and license to the V3 package. Do not package SF Pro.
tokens.numeric_features: tabular-nums where supported; keep decimal places exactly as supplied
tokens.border_radius_rule: Only meaningful grouped panels are rounded. Images remain uncropped beyond verified asset crops and have no rounded masks.

coordinate_convention.box: [left, top, width, height], pixels; text y is line-box top, not baseline
coordinate_convention.text: Use supplied explicit newlines. Do not shrink fonts to fit. If browser metrics differ, report and reflow while preserving reading order and stated minimum sizes.
coordinate_convention.arrows: Arrowhead size about 12 px for stroke 3–4; arrowheads must point toward the stated destination.
coordinate_convention.chart_adaptation: Rebuild at final 1080px coordinates using the data and elements below. Never embed the complete landscape SVG at reduced scale.
coordinate_convention.layering: Elements appear in drawing order. Text is always above shapes but must not cover source image controls.

publication.disclosure: Official image and exact crops are limited product-specific educational quotations. Attribution does not establish republication permission. Do not claim blanket copyright clearance or publish externally without separate approval/rights review.
publication.image_state: Official image: DUAL highlighted, BPM highlighted, 120 BPM, L 1/8D, R 1/2. It is not the Ping Pong / HOST tutorial recipe.
publication.artifact_sources: Carry assets.json, sources.md, and source-image disclaimers into the editable package.

pages.title: 给人声一点空间

elements.text: 低 Wet 的 Ping Pong Delay

主唱已经够清楚，只想再添一点空间？
让少量延迟信号在左右交替，
用干湿比例控制它的存在感。

Waves 官方界面，仅用于定位控件。
图为 DUAL / BPM 状态；参数不是本教程设置。
时间位置（图中为 R 声道）
先把时间、反馈和滤波分开调。
界面：Waves 官方产品页 · © Waves Audio Ltd.

must_not: Do not relabel DELAY R inside the screenshot.
Do not state Ping Pong or HOST is enabled in this official image.

pages.title: 低 Wet 插入，信号怎么走？

elements.text: 低 Wet 插入，信号怎么走？

插在人声轨，干声与 Delay 在插件内部混合。
单声道人声选 M>S；立体声轨选 Stereo。
功能路由示意，不是插件内部精确 DSP 电路。

原人声直接进混音；效果轨 Dry/Wet 设为 100。
只返回处理后的信号，
再用发送量或返回推子调多少。

Dry/Wet 5 是插件读数，
不能直接当成干湿电平比或响度比。
功能依据：Waves H-Delay User Guide · 路由为示意

must_not: The only dry split in the large insert diagram is inside the H-Delay boundary.
Feedback must tap Delay output and return to Delay input, never the Dry/Wet mix.
The send comparison is prose, not a second miniature landscape diagram.

pages.title: 同一个 1/8，速度不同就不同

elements.text: 同一个 1/8，速度不同就不同
普通时值 · 固定速度 · 四分音符为一拍
HOST 跟随工程速度；歌词密度仍需试听。
手册默认 1/8D；加载预设后复核。

Waves 官方局部：120 BPM / 1/8D / 1/2，BPM 状态。
仅辨认字符，非本教程设置。© Waves Audio Ltd.
计算：60,000 / BPM · 默认时值：H-Delay User Guide p.8

must_not: Do not align the official 120 BPM dotted-note screenshot with the ordinary-note bars as if it were the recipe.
Do not draw a second tiny dotted-note chart; use the prominent exact numeric comparison.
Keep the four bars on one shared linear millisecond scale.

pages.title: Ping Pong，交替的是延迟声部

elements.text: Ping Pong，交替的是延迟声部
160 BPM · 普通 1/8 · 单次短输入 · 从左开始

相邻重复间隔 187.5 ms。
干声保持原有声像，延迟声部提供左右运动。

选 Stereo 或 M>S，
打开 PING PONG。

Waves 官方局部，仅定位按钮，不表示已开启。
© Waves Audio Ltd.

必要时暂时提高 Dry/Wet 辨认，再收回低 Wet。
时序示意，非实测；左右起点可换，点大小不表示振幅。
“> 1”为插件读数，不是模型系数 g。
功能与门槛：Waves H-Delay User Guide p.4、p.10

must_not: Dry event is separate from L/R lanes; its vertical position does not assert a center-panned dry signal.
Identical dots mark events, not equal measured amplitudes.
PING PONG source button is unmodified and cannot be described as enabled.

pages.title: Feedback 管重复，Dry/Wet 管混合

elements.text: Feedback 管重复，Dry/Wet 管混合

把第 1 次延迟信号的振幅统一为 100。
假设每次反馈回送固定比例，看后续怎样衰减。

第一下合适，
后面拖太久
→ 先减它

整个延迟声部
太明显
→ 先减它
Waves 官方局部；旋钮位置不是教程起点。© Waves Audio Ltd.

理想线性模型：第 n 次振幅 = 100 × g⁽ⁿ⁻¹⁾。
不含滤波和饱和；g 不是 H-Delay 旋钮读数。
图为计算示意，振幅倍数不等于响度倍数。
反馈定义：Waves / FabFilter · 数列为独立计算

must_not: The chart uses a shared 0–100 relative-amplitude axis.
Do not relabel model coefficients as H-Delay Feedback 30 or 60.
Do not make the official knob positions appear to correspond to chart values.

pages.title: 滤波，让延迟声部让出位置

elements.text: 滤波，让延迟声部让出位置

高通减少低频，低通收暗高频。
只处理延迟声部；实际效果放回伴奏判断。

Waves 官方滤波区；图中旋钮位置不是教程设置。
© Waves Audio Ltd.

低频仍浑：HiPASS 200 → 300 Hz
齿音突出：LoPASS 6 → 4 kHz
一次只改一个截止点；太薄或太暗就往回调。

数值仅为试听起点；图只表示滤波方向。
截止点外逐渐衰减，不是完全切除或实测频响。
功能：H-Delay User Guide · 200 Hz / 6 kHz 为本文试听起点

must_not: Never draw an invented frequency-response slope, dB axis, brick wall, or measured curve.
Frequency positions must be logarithmic, with no linear spacing of 200 and 6000.
Screenshot values are not the 200 Hz / 6 kHz recipe.

pages.title: 从这组参数，做一次对照

elements.text: 从这组参数，做一次对照
整组为试听起点，不是官方预设。
数字按 H-Delay 显示值记录。

ANALOG OFF · LoFi 关 · MODULATION DEPTH 0
ØL / ØR 关
2  选定混合后：比较普通 1/8 与 1/16。

3  尾巴太久，Feedback 从 20 往下收；
   需要更多延续，再小幅增加。

每次只听一个变化。数字不是干湿电平比例；
留意输出峰值，避免削波。
操作清单：本文试听建议 · 功能名称按 Waves 手册

must_not: Do not put these numbers on the official screenshot.
Do not render simulated H-Delay knobs, buttons, or preset chrome.
M>S means mono input to stereo output; M/S is a different concept.

pages.title: 最后，回到整首歌

elements.text: 先找到问题，再动对应的控制项。
歌词、句尾、下一句仍然清楚吗？

尽量匹配开关前后的响度，
再判断空间感。

合并 L + R，
听音色、音量和平衡是否明显变差。
合适就好，已经够了就不必再加。

单声道检查不是只听左声道。未经音频实测，
固定设置不保证更宽、更清楚或兼容单声道。
诊断为试听建议 · 参考 Waves、iZotope 官方教程

must_not: Do not add fabricated waveform, width, correlation, LUFS, or before/after measurements.
L + R is fold-down; it must not be depicted as listening only to one channel.

qa_requirements: Inspect every full-size page and 360×480 preview before delivery.
Check exact text widths with the packaged font; no automated font shrinking.
Essential chart labels 30–34 px; body 36–40 px; caveats at least 26 px.
Review every arrow and numerical scale against diagram_data.json.
Confirm DUAL/BPM disclaimers beside all screenshot uses.
Keep original source PNG and crop pixels unchanged.
Confirm FEEDBACK display threshold > 1 is not model g.
Keep Delay, Dry/Wet, Feedback, M>S, HOST, PING PONG, HiPASS, LoPASS, ANALOG, LoFi, MODULATION DEPTH, ØL / ØR exact.
Keep all publication-rights limitations in the delivery note; no external posting.
Read generated PNG/PDF text for glyph fallback, clipping, decimal errors, and unintended wraps.
